canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for retail, mirroring telecom: catalog.py's 'retail' GROUPS entry only defines retail_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific balance-sheet/income template the way banking or insurance have one.

same_store_sales_growth (like-for-like) is the single most-watched retail metric and is frequently disclosed only for a subset of formats (e.g. hypermarkets but not convenience) -- when an issuer discloses it per-format rather than company-wide, this pack treats the company-wide figure as unavailable (not_disclosed) rather than averaging the per-format figures into a fabricated blended rate.

ecommerce_revenue_share is new enough in Saudi retail disclosure that several issuers only began reporting it from FY2023; a company with no pre-2023 figure is correctly event_not_observed for those periods, not a gap in collection.
